Our Leadership

Ridgeline is fortunate to be led by visionaries who have spent their careers applying technology, creativity, and passion to solve difficult problems for business professionals.

Board of Directors

Dave Duffield

Founder and Chairman

Dave Duffield

Founder and Chairman

Dave’s distinguished career in business software spans more than five decades. He has founded or co-founded six enterprise software companies, including the world-class public companies PeopleSoft and Workday. Each delivered software and technology ahead of its time to benefit businesses and institutions across the globe. Dave was an early adopter of core values and the belief that happy employees lead to happy customers.

George Tenet

Board Member

George Tenet

Board Member

George Tenet is currently Chairman Emeritus of Allen and Company LLC, a privately held investment bank. Previously, Mr. Tenet served under Presidents Bill Clinton and George W. Bush as the 18th Director of Central Intelligence from 1997 to 2004. In this position, he led the U.S. Intelligence Community and presided over the daily activities of the CIA.

Mr. Tenet has received many awards for his public service, including the Presidential Medal of Freedom, the United States' highest civilian honor. Mr. Tenet received a BSFS from Georgetown University and a MIA from Columbia University. He is the author of At the Center of the Storm (2007), a best-selling memoir of his life in the CIA.

Robynne Daly

Board Member

Robynne Daly

Board Member

Robynne Daly currently serves on the board of directors for Unity Software, Lyra Health, and the University of Hawaii Foundation.  She previously spent 12 years at Workday in various senior roles, including vice chair, co-president, CFO and chief accounting officer.  Prior to joining Workday, Robynne was chief accounting officer and corporate controller at VMware, served as senior vice president and chief accounting officer at VeriSign, and served as assistant controller at Oracle. She also held senior finance roles at Visa, General Electric, and Ford.

Robynne holds a master of business administration degree in finance from Golden Gate University and a bachelor’s degree in economics and accounting from Claremont McKenna College.

Mike Frandsen

Board Member

Mike Frandsen

Board Member

Mike has 40+ years of experience in consulting and application software.  He held leadership positions at Andersen Consulting (now Accenture), PeopleSoft, and Workday. He was also the CEO at a green energy startup as well as a provider of SaaS-based retail promotion management applications.

Mike served on the boards of Zendesk and Advent Software prior to the sale of those companies. He is currently a director for the Workday Foundation. Mike holds a bachelor's degree in business from the University of Colorado.

Executive Team

Dave Blair

Chief Executive Officer

Dave Blair

Chief Executive Officer

As Ridgeline’s CEO, Dave brings a modern, cloud-based product and technology focus to Ridgeline. Dave has 30 years of experience bringing new solutions to the market in the investment management software industry. Prior to joining Ridgeline in 2020, Dave led multiple product areas at SS&C Advent over 28 years and helped oversee Advent’s entire portfolio of software solutions.

Mike Duffield

SVP of Go to Market

Mike Duffield

SVP of Go to Market

For Mike, success in sales and marketing starts with a partnership grounded in honesty, thoughtfulness, and like-minded core values. These principles developed over 30 years of leading sales initiatives at PeopleSoft and Workday, where he worked closely with organizations of all sizes to modernize their administrative systems. Before joining Ridgeline, Mike co-founded and served as CEO of Alchemy, a leading Workday Higher Education solutions partner.

Lisa Faucher

SVP of People and Operations

Lisa Faucher

SVP of People and Operations

Lisa oversees Ridgeline’s Operations functions, which include HR & Workplace, Talent Acquisition, Program Management, Production Operations, Technical Documentation, Legal and Finance. In her role, Lisa ensures the alignment of Ridgeline's strategic goals with its operational capabilities, driving initiatives that enhance employee engagement, operational efficiency, and overall company performance. Prior to joining Ridgeline, Lisa spent 18 years at Workday in various positions within the Services, Sales, and Products organization as well as the Office of the COO. Lisa is a graduate of the University of Rhode Island.

Jack Lynch

Chief Strategy Officer

Jack Lynch

Chief Strategy Officer

Jack brings deep knowledge of enterprise technology to his strategy leadership role at Ridgeline. A student of disruptive technologies, Jack motivates Ridgeline with his energy, optimism, and personal investment in people, teams, and relationships. Prior to Ridgeline, Jack led a global products and solutions team specializing in industry-specific solutions at IBM Watson.

Jeremy Hittle

Chief Security Officer

Jeremy Hittle

Chief Security Officer

As Ridgeline’s Chief Security Officer, Jeremy is responsible for building and overseeing all security, compliance, and IT programs and needs at Ridgeline. His 20 years of IT, security, fraud, and compliance experience in both the consumer and enterprise spaces have given him a unique vision that helps Ridgeline place security and privacy at the center of our product, technology, and engineering choices. Jeremy also served as the Chief Security Officer and Vice President of Security at Workday before joining Ridgeline.

Bridget Barrot

SVP of Customer Experience

Bridget Barrot

SVP of Customer Experience

Bridget is an accomplished executive with 20+ years in global customer-facing roles, including 10 years in fintech with companies like FactSet and Chainalysis, leading and scaling teams across all post-sales functions. She is an experienced speaker and advisor, championing customer-led growth and innovative customer success strategies. At Ridgeline, she oversees Consulting, Customer Success, Support and CX Operations. Bridget is a graduate of Loyola University in Maryland.

Daniel Eriksson

SVP of Product

Daniel Eriksson

SVP of Product

Daniel has over 20 years of experience shaping product strategy and growth in investment management technology. A believer in finding and trusting in great people, he has led teams delivering award-winning solutions across portfolio accounting, client communications, trading, compliance, and data management. His career spans markets in North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific, giving him a broad perspective on how technology advances the global investment management industry. Before joining Ridgeline, Daniel spent 24 years at SS&C Advent, where he launched new products and services, guided acquisitions, and drove continuous efficient growth, guided by the northern star of delivering greater value to customers.

David Zhou

Head of Finance

David Zhou

Head of Finance

David leads Finance at Ridgeline, with a focus on capital allocation and building financial rigor to support growth and long-term value creation. A firm believer in finance as a strategic partner to the business, David brings more than 15 years of experience across public and private companies in technology and financial services. Prior to Ridgeline, David led Corporate Finance at SoFi through its IPO and held finance leadership roles at Box, Intel, and Procter & Gamble. David earned his MBA from the UCLA Anderson School of Management.

Erica Lied

VP of Business Innovation and Operations

Erica Lied

VP of Business Innovation and Operations

Erica leads Human Resources and Workplace at Ridgeline. She brings a passion for developing high-performing organizations, designing HR programming that motivate talent, and creating a culture where employees can bring their full selves to work. Erica believes employees are the heart, soul, and competitive advantage of any company (not to mention one of Ridgeline's core values!). Prior to Ridgeline, Erica worked across several billion dollar brands at Procter & Gamble in both Human Resources and Sales.

Bert Forsythe

VP of Legal

Bert Forsythe

VP of Legal

Bert leads Ridgeline's legal team. He joined from Workday, and previously Scout RFP, where he focused on enabling the hypergrowth of emerging enterprise software products and companies. Earlier in his career, Bert worked on Wall Street and then in Silicon Valley, counseling corporate, financial institution and investment firm clients on a variety of matters.

Moran Eliahu

Head of Human Resources

Moran Eliahu

Head of Human Resources

Moran Eliahu is Head of Human Resources at Ridgeline, leading the HR function as a strategic partner in building a high‑performance, values‑driven culture. Moran’s team advances Ridgeline’s long-term growth by integrating business partnerships, people programs, operations, systems, and employee experience into a cohesive people strategy. With more than a decade of experience in high‑growth software companies, including Samsara and Evernote, Moran has built and scaled HR teams that specialize in org design, change management, leadership development, and employee engagement.

Lauren Lund

VP of Marketing

Lauren Lund

VP of Marketing

Lauren leads the Marketing team at Ridgeline, responsible for elevating the company’s brand, driving customer advocacy, and supporting growth goals. With nearly 20 years experience across marketing, go-to-market strategy, and leadership, Lauren's career has focused on building and scaling teams to support rapid growth at various-sized organizations. Prior to joining Ridgeline, Lauren led marketing teams at OneSource Virtual, Coursera and Workday. Lauren is a graduate of the University of Michigan.

Core values are the beliefs that are most important to Ridgeline. They serve as our moral compass and the basis for our decisions and actions, making us a better place to work, a more desirable partner, and a committed supporter of our communities.

Dave Duffield, Founder and Chairman
